verses.ar: اَلصِّيتُ أَفْضَلُ مِنَ ٱلْغِنَى ٱلْعَظِيمِ، وَٱلنِّعْمَةُ ٱلصَّالِحَةُ أَفْضَلُ مِنَ ٱلْفِضَّةِ وَٱلذَّهَبِ.
verses.kjv: A [good] name [is] rather to be chosen than great riches, [and] loving favour rather than silver and gold.
verses.web: A good name is more desirable than great riches, and loving favor is better than silver and gold.
verses.he: נִבְחָ֣ר שֵׁ֭ם מֵעֹ֣שֶׁר רָ֑ב מִכֶּ֥סֶף וּ֝מִזָּהָ֗ב חֵ֣ן טֹֽוב׃

verses.ar: اَلْغَنِيُّ وَٱلْفَقِيرُ يَتَلَاقَيَانِ، صَانِعُهُمَا كِلَيْهِمَا ٱلرَّبُّ.
verses.kjv: The rich and poor meet together: the LORD [is] the maker of them all.
verses.web: The rich and the poor have this in common: Yahweh is the maker of them all.
verses.he: עָשִׁ֣יר וָרָ֣שׁ נִפְגָּ֑שׁוּ עֹשֵׂ֖ה כֻלָּ֣ם יְהוָֽה׃

verses.ar: اَلذَّكِيُّ يُبْصِرُ ٱلشَّرَّ فَيَتَوَارَى، وَٱلْحَمْقَى يَعْبُرُونَ فَيُعَاقَبُونَ.
verses.kjv: A prudent [man] foreseeth the evil, and hideth himself: but the simple pass on, and are punished.
verses.web: A prudent man sees danger and hides himself; but the simple pass on, and suffer for it.
verses.he: עָר֤וּם ׀ רָאָ֣ה רָעָ֣ה *וְיִסָּתֵר (וְנִסְתָּ֑ר) וּ֝פְתָיִ֗ים עָבְר֥וּ וְֽנֶעֱנָֽשׁוּ׃

verses.ar: ثَوَابُ ٱلتَّوَاضُعِ وَمَخَافَةِ ٱلرَّبِّ هُوَ غِنًى وَكَرَامَةٌ وَحَيَاةٌ.
verses.kjv: By humility [and] the fear of the LORD [are] riches, and honour, and life.
verses.web: The result of humility and the fear of Yahweh is wealth, honor, and life.
verses.he: עֵ֣קֶב עֲ֭נָוָה יִרְאַ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה עֹ֖שֶׁר וְכָבֹ֣וד וְחַיִּֽים׃

verses.ar: شَوْكٌ وَفُخُوخٌ فِي طَرِيقِ ٱلْمُلْتَوِي. مَنْ يَحْفَظْ نَفْسَهُ يَبْتَعِدْ عَنْهَا.
verses.kjv: Thorns [and] snares [are] in the way of the froward: he that doth keep his soul shall be far from them.
verses.web: Thorns and snares are in the path of the wicked; whoever guards his soul stays far from them.
verses.he: צִנִּ֣ים פַּ֭חִים בְּדֶ֣רֶךְ עִקֵּ֑שׁ שֹׁומֵ֥ר נַ֝פְשֹׁ֗ו יִרְחַ֥ק מֵהֶֽם׃

verses.ar: رَبِّ ٱلْوَلَدَ فِي طَرِيقِهِ، فَمَتَى شَاخَ أَيْضًا لَا يَحِيدُ عَنْهُ.
verses.kjv: Train up a child in the way he should go: and when he is old, he will not depart from it.
verses.web: Train up a child in the way he should go, and when he is old he will not depart from it.
verses.he: חֲנֹ֣ךְ לַ֭נַּעַר עַל־פִּ֣י דַרְכֹּ֑ו גַּ֥ם כִּֽי־יַ֝זְקִ֗ין לֹֽא־יָס֥וּר מִמֶּֽנָּה׃

verses.ar: اَلْغَنِيُّ يَتَسَلَّطُ عَلَى ٱلْفَقِيرِ، وَٱلْمُقْتَرِضُ عَبْدٌ لِلْمُقْرِضِ.
verses.kjv: The rich ruleth over the poor, and the borrower [is] servant to the lender.
verses.web: The rich rule over the poor. The borrower is servant to the lender.
verses.he: עָ֭שִׁיר בְּרָשִׁ֣ים יִמְשֹׁ֑ול וְעֶ֥בֶד לֹ֝וֶ֗ה לְאִ֣ישׁ מַלְוֶֽה׃

verses.ar: ٱلزَّارِعُ إِثْمًا يَحْصُدُ بَلِيَّةً، وَعَصَا سَخَطِهِ تَفْنَى.
verses.kjv: He that soweth iniquity shall reap vanity: and the rod of his anger shall fail.
verses.web: He who sows wickedness reaps trouble, and the rod of his fury will be destroyed.
verses.he: זֹורֵ֣עַ עַ֭וְלָה *יִקְצֹור־ (יִקְצָר)־אָ֑וֶן וְשֵׁ֖בֶט עֶבְרָתֹ֣ו יִכְלֶֽה׃

verses.ar: اَلصَّالِحُ ٱلْعَيْنِ هُوَ يُبَارَكُ، لِأَنَّهُ يُعْطِي مِنْ خُبْزِهِ لِلْفَقِيرِ.
verses.kjv: He that hath a bountiful eye shall be blessed; for he giveth of his bread to the poor.
verses.web: He who has a generous eye will be blessed, for he shares his food with the poor.
verses.he: טֹֽוב־עַ֭יִן ה֣וּא יְבֹרָ֑ךְ כִּֽי־נָתַ֖ן מִלַּחְמֹ֣ו לַדָּֽל׃

verses.ar: أُطْرُدِ ٱلْمُسْتَهْزِئَ فَيَخْرُجَ ٱلْخِصَامُ، وَيَبْطُلَ ٱلنِّزَاعُ وَٱلْخِزْيُ.
verses.kjv: Cast out the scorner, and contention shall go out; yea, strife and reproach shall cease.
verses.web: Drive out the mocker, and strife will go out; yes, quarrels and insults will stop.
verses.he: גָּ֣רֵֽשׁ לֵ֭ץ וְיֵצֵ֣א מָדֹ֑ון וְ֝יִשְׁבֹּ֗ת דִּ֣ין וְקָלֹֽון׃

verses.ar: مَنْ أَحَبَّ طَهَارَةَ ٱلْقَلْبِ، فَلِنِعْمَةِ شَفَتَيْهِ يَكُونُ ٱلْمَلِكُ صَدِيقَهُ.
verses.kjv: He that loveth pureness of heart, [for] the grace of his lips the king [shall be] his friend.
verses.web: He who loves purity of heart and speaks gracefully is the king’s friend.
verses.he: אֹהֵ֥ב *טְהֹור־ (טְהָר)־לֵ֑ב חֵ֥ן שְׂ֝פָתָ֗יו רֵעֵ֥הוּ מֶֽלֶךְ׃

verses.ar: عَيْنَا ٱلرَّبِّ تَحْفَظَانِ ٱلْمَعْرِفَةَ، وَهُوَ يَقْلِبُ كَلَامَ ٱلْغَادِرِينَ.
verses.kjv: The eyes of the LORD preserve knowledge, and he overthroweth the words of the transgressor.
verses.web: Yahweh’s eyes watch over knowledge, but he frustrates the words of the unfaithful.
verses.he: עֵינֵ֣י יְ֭הוָה נָ֣צְרוּ דָ֑עַת וַ֝יְסַלֵּ֗ף דִּבְרֵ֥י בֹגֵֽד׃

verses.ar: قَالَ ٱلْكَسْلَانُ: «ٱلْأَسَدُ فِي ٱلْخَارِجِ، فَأُقْتَلُ فِي ٱلشَّوَارِعِ!».
verses.kjv: The slothful [man] saith, [There is] a lion without, I shall be slain in the streets.
verses.web: The sluggard says, “There is a lion outside! I will be killed in the streets!”
verses.he: אָמַ֣ר עָ֭צֵל אֲרִ֣י בַח֑וּץ בְּתֹ֥וךְ רְ֝חֹבֹ֗ות אֵֽרָצֵֽחַ׃

verses.ar: فَمُ ٱلْأَجْنَبِيَّاتِ هُوَّةٌ عَمِيقَةٌ. مَمْقُوتُ ٱلرَّبِّ يَسْقُطُ فِيهَا.
verses.kjv: The mouth of strange women [is] a deep pit: he that is abhorred of the LORD shall fall therein.
verses.web: The mouth of an adulteress is a deep pit. He who is under Yahweh’s wrath will fall into it.
verses.he: שׁוּחָ֣ה עֲ֭מֻקָּה פִּ֣י זָרֹ֑ות זְע֥וּם יְ֝הוָ֗ה *יִפֹּול־ (יִפָּל)־שָֽׁם׃

verses.ar: اَلْجَهَالَةُ مُرْتَبِطَةٌ بِقَلْبِ ٱلْوَلَدِ. عَصَا ٱلتَّأْدِيبِ تُبْعِدُهَا عَنْهُ.
verses.kjv: Foolishness [is] bound in the heart of a child; [but] the rod of correction shall drive it far from him.
verses.web: Folly is bound up in the heart of a child; the rod of discipline drives it far from him.
verses.he: אִ֭וֶּלֶת קְשׁוּרָ֣ה בְלֶב־נָ֑עַר שֵׁ֥בֶט מ֝וּסָ֗ר יַרְחִיקֶ֥נָּה מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃

verses.ar: ظَالِمُ ٱلْفَقِيرِ تَكْثِيرًا لِمَا لَهُ، وَمُعْطِي ٱلْغَنِيِّ، إِنَّمَا هُمَا لِلْعَوَزِ.
verses.kjv: He that oppresseth the poor to increase his [riches, and] he that giveth to the rich, [shall] surely [come] to want.
verses.web: Whoever oppresses the poor for his own increase and whoever gives to the rich, both come to poverty.
verses.he: עֹ֣שֵֽׁק דָּ֭ל לְהַרְבֹּ֣ות לֹ֑ו נֹתֵ֥ן לְ֝עָשִׁ֗יר אַךְ־לְמַחְסֹֽור׃

verses.ar: أَمِلْ أُذْنَكَ وَٱسْمَعْ كَلَامَ ٱلْحُكَمَاءِ، وَوَجِّهْ قَلْبَكَ إِلَى مَعْرِفَتِي،
verses.kjv: Bow down thine ear, and hear the words of the wise, and apply thine heart unto my knowledge.
verses.web: Turn your ear, and listen to the words of the wise. Apply your heart to my teaching.
verses.he: הַ֥ט אָזְנְךָ֗ וּ֭שְׁמַע דִּבְרֵ֣י חֲכָמִ֑ים וְ֝לִבְּךָ֗ תָּשִׁ֥ית לְדַעְתִּֽי׃

verses.ar: لِأَنَّهُ حَسَنٌ إِنْ حَفِظْتَهَا فِي جَوْفِكَ، إِنْ تَتَثَبَّتْ جَمِيعًا عَلَى شَفَتَيْكَ.
verses.kjv: For [it is] a pleasant thing if thou keep them within thee; they shall withal be fitted in thy lips.
verses.web: For it is a pleasant thing if you keep them within you, if all of them are ready on your lips.
verses.he: כִּֽי־נָ֭עִים כִּֽי־תִשְׁמְרֵ֣ם בְּבִטְנֶ֑ךָ יִכֹּ֥נוּ יַ֝חְדָּ֗ו עַל־שְׂפָתֶֽיךָ׃

verses.ar: لِيَكُونَ ٱتِّكَالُكَ عَلَى ٱلرَّبِّ، عَرَّفْتُكَ أَنْتَ ٱلْيَوْمَ.
verses.kjv: That thy trust may be in the LORD, I have made known to thee this day, even to thee.
verses.web: I teach you today, even you, so that your trust may be in Yahweh.
verses.he: לִהְיֹ֣ות בַּ֭יהוָה מִבְטַחֶ֑ךָ הֹודַעְתִּ֖יךָ הַיֹּ֣ום אַף־אָֽתָּה׃

verses.ar: أَلَمْ أَكْتُبْ لَكَ أُمُورًا شَرِيفَةً مِنْ جِهَةِ مُؤَامَرَةٍ وَمَعْرِفَةٍ؟
verses.kjv: Have not I written to thee excellent things in counsels and knowledge,
verses.web: Haven’t I written to you thirty excellent things of counsel and knowledge,
verses.he: הֲלֹ֤א כָתַ֣בְתִּי לְ֭ךָ *שִׁלְשֹׁום (שָׁלִישִׁ֑ים) בְּמֹ֖ועֵצֹ֣ת וָדָֽעַת׃

verses.ar: لِأُعَلِّمَكَ قِسْطَ كَلَامِ ٱلْحَقِّ، لِتَرُدَّ جَوَابَ ٱلْحَقِّ لِلَّذِينَ أَرْسَلُوكَ.
verses.kjv: That I might make thee know the certainty of the words of truth; that thou mightest answer the words of truth to them that send unto thee?
verses.web: To teach you truth, reliable words, to give sound answers to the ones who sent you?
verses.he: לְהֹודִֽיעֲךָ֗ קֹ֭שְׁטְ אִמְרֵ֣י אֱמֶ֑ת לְהָשִׁ֥יב אֲמָרִ֥ים אֱ֝מֶ֗ת לְשֹׁלְחֶֽיךָ׃ פ

verses.ar: لَا تَسْلُبِ ٱلْفَقِيرَ لِكَوْنِهِ فَقِيرًا، وَلَا تَسْحَقِ ٱلْمِسْكِينَ فِي ٱلْبَابِ،
verses.kjv: Rob not the poor, because he [is] poor: neither oppress the afflicted in the gate:
verses.web: Don’t exploit the poor because he is poor; and don’t crush the needy in court;
verses.he: אַֽל־תִּגְזָל־דָּ֭ל כִּ֣י דַל־ה֑וּא וְאַל־תְּדַכֵּ֖א עָנִ֣י בַשָּֽׁעַר׃

verses.ar: لِأَنَّ ٱلرَّبَّ يُقِيمُ دَعْوَاهُمْ، وَيَسْلُبُ سَالِبِي أَنْفُسِهِمْ.
verses.kjv: For the LORD will plead their cause, and spoil the soul of those that spoiled them.
verses.web: for Yahweh will plead their case, and plunder the life of those who plunder them.
verses.he: כִּֽי־יְ֭הוָה יָרִ֣יב רִיבָ֑ם וְקָבַ֖ע אֶת־קֹבְעֵיהֶ֣ם נָֽפֶשׁ׃

verses.ar: لَاتَسْتَصْحِبْ غَضُوبًا، وَمَعَ رَجُلٍ سَاخِطٍ لَاتَجِيءْ،
verses.kjv: Make no friendship with an angry man; and with a furious man thou shalt not go:
verses.web: Don’t befriend a hot-tempered man. Don’t associate with one who harbors anger,
verses.he: אַל־תִּ֭תְרַע אֶת־בַּ֣עַל אָ֑ף וְאֶת־אִ֥ישׁ חֵ֝מֹות לֹ֣א תָבֹֽוא׃

verses.ar: لِئَلَّا تَأْلَفَ طُرُقَهُ، وَتَأْخُذَ شَرَكًا إِلَى نَفْسِكَ.
verses.kjv: Lest thou learn his ways, and get a snare to thy soul.
verses.web: lest you learn his ways and ensnare your soul.
verses.he: פֶּן־תֶּאֱלַ֥ף *אָרְחָתֹו (אֹֽרְחֹתָ֑יו) וְלָקַחְתָּ֖ מֹוקֵ֣שׁ לְנַפְשֶֽׁךָ׃

verses.ar: لَا تَكُنْ مِنْ صَافِقِي ٱلْكَفِّ، وَلَا مِنْ ضَامِنِي ٱلدُّيُونِ.
verses.kjv: Be not thou [one] of them that strike hands, [or] of them that are sureties for debts.
verses.web: Don’t you be one of those who strike hands, of those who are collateral for debts.
verses.he: אַל־תְּהִ֥י בְתֹֽקְעֵי־כָ֑ף בַּ֝עֹרְבִ֗ים מַשָּׁאֹֽות׃

verses.ar: إِنْ لَمْ يَكُنْ لَكَ مَا تَفِي، فَلِمَاذَا يَأْخُذُ فِرَاشَكَ مِنْ تَحْتِكَ؟
verses.kjv: If thou hast nothing to pay, why should he take away thy bed from under thee?
verses.web: If you don’t have means to pay, why should he take away your bed from under you?
verses.he: אִם־אֵֽין־לְךָ֥ לְשַׁלֵּ֑ם לָ֥מָּה יִקַּ֥ח מִ֝שְׁכָּבְךָ֗ מִתַּחְתֶּֽיךָ׃

verses.ar: لَا تَنْقُلِ ٱلتُّخْمَ ٱلْقَدِيمَ ٱلَّذِي وَضَعَهُ آبَاؤُكَ.
verses.kjv: Remove not the ancient landmark, which thy fathers have set.
verses.web: Don’t move the ancient boundary stone which your fathers have set up.
verses.he: אַל־תַּ֭סֵּג גְּב֣וּל עֹולָ֑ם אֲשֶׁ֖ר עָשׂ֣וּ אֲבֹותֶֽיךָ׃

verses.ar: أَرَأَيْتَ رَجُلًا مُجْتَهِدًا فِي عَمَلِهِ؟ أَمَامَ ٱلْمُلُوكِ يَقِفُ. لَايَقِفُ أَمَامَ ٱلرَّعَاعِ!
verses.kjv: Seest thou a man diligent in his business? he shall stand before kings; he shall not stand before mean [men].
verses.web: Do you see a man skilled in his work? He will serve kings. He won’t serve obscure men.
verses.he: חָזִ֡יתָ אִ֤ישׁ ׀ מָ֘הִ֤יר בִּמְלַאכְתֹּ֗ו לִֽפְנֵֽי־מְלָכִ֥ים יִתְיַצָּ֑ב בַּל־יִ֝תְיַצֵּב לִפְנֵ֥י חֲשֻׁכִּֽים׃ פ
